# Literature Review

## Purpose

Synthesize and compare a broader approved literature corpus across root-supplied batches.

## Preconditions

Use explicit workflow approval. Any declared network or multiple-repository orchestration is handled by the root; the worker receives contained snapshots and artifacts only.

## Inputs

Use the supplied source corpus and provenance, prior scan Results, objective and criteria, and conflict or gap context.

## Procedure

Group sources by question or method, compare agreement and contradiction, assess provenance and evidence strength, identify unresolved gaps, and produce a review synthesis and root-side next-step plan.

## Outputs

Return exactly one strict Result with the comparative review plus one pending Proposal with supported evidence or claim suggestions or a root-side follow-up plan.

## Checks and Stop Conditions

Stop on missing provenance, corpus drift, an undeclared source or repository, a need for direct network access, or inability to separate evidence from interpretation.

## Authority Boundaries

Do not fetch sources, traverse additional repositories, launch scans or Dispatches, promote Claims, mutate canonical Research, or treat approval as expanded worker authority.
